Ford, a large car making group, recently announced they are cutting jobs and criticizing the UK government. They are currently unhappy with the government's operation of new rules that require them to sell a high figure of electric vehicles every single year.

Female leaders and other executives at the company used to sing a completely different tune just a couple of years ago. In 2022, they actually wanted the government to push electric car sales even harder so their green investments would bear fruit, but now that customer demand has dropped, they are complaining and saying the rules are impossible to follow.
